newsitem.title: UK: UK's Clarke-CIPS survey shows services "booming".
newsitem.headline: UK's Clarke-CIPS survey shows services "booming".

text.p: Britain's Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke on Thursday welcomed results of a new CIPS survey which showed strong growth in the services sector.

"Britain's service sector is booming. Employment is rising and most firms expect business to increase over the next year," said Clarke. "We must keep in place for the next five years the policies and stable economic conditions which have enabled Britain's service industries to do so well."

The Chartered Institute of Purchasing and Supply (CIPS) said the service sector picked up in March, with output, business, employment and prices all up from February. --London Newsdesk +44 171 542 7715
